description: Read current perpetual funding (fonlama/takas ücreti), open interest and positioning directly by symbol, without loading candles first. Optional ref reuses a fresh derivatives handle. Funding is a transfer between longs/shorts, NOT a maker/taker trading commission. Returns decimal and percentage rates, actual settlement interval and optional payment scenario.

notionalQuote.description: Optional hypothetical position value in quote units to estimate one funding payment.

symbol.description: Default chart symbol; perpetual funding is read on futures even when the chart is spot.

timeframe.description: Aggregation for OI/positioning; not the funding settlement interval.

name: market_derivatives
